construction: One contrast direction per site in the complement of the native all-token 99% input covariance span, excluding the exact affine LayerNorm null. Maximize beta-path input power relative to native power. Outgoing vector is the leading task-increment left singular vector, scaled by expert matrix Frobenius norm. Six joint coefficients use one closed signed-margin solve with native-margin metric and fixed caps. No scans or defender gradients.
margin: Fixed non-label runner-up at each reference model; relative change divided by max(original signed margin,0.1*median positive margin). Reference-correct calibration samples only enter each objective. g averages signed beta derivatives, including beta chain scaling; c is negative inverse native-margin Gram times g, rescaled once to fixed caps.
calibration: 256 new target training images AND LABELS for covariance, outgoing selection and signed objective. 256 disjoint target training confirmations after release freeze. No official test data, future partner weights or inputs during construction.
evaluation: Regardless of proxy result, evaluate this one frozen candidate native/direct/original author AGA with matched unprotected controls. Eight experts at TA0.2, two official tests; not Table6 exact agreement. Test prefix replays and independent NumPy coefficient/count verification required.
limits: PCA complement is only approximately low-sensitive on calibration, not a true task zero space. Signed local proxy objective does not guarantee real fusion damage or utility. Input contrast and task left singular vectors are existing linear algebra; no innovation claim. Public cleanup is necessary if protection appears. No reconstruction or universal attack-survival prerequisite.
